policy: All Pokémon Ruby item gameplay parameters follow Pokémon Emerald canonical ordering and values.
localization_policy: Names and descriptions are localization data and are synchronized separately; this manifest is the gameplay-parameter authority.

known_engine_dependencies.ITEM_POMEG_BERRY..ITEM_TAMATO_BERRY: Emerald ReduceEV use path and signed EV effect handling must be ported for exact runtime behavior.
known_engine_dependencies.ITEM_POWDER_JAR: Emerald Berry Powder/Berry Crush save subsystem is absent from Ruby and must be ported for exact runtime behavior.
